payload.evidence_summary: Initial screening rejected stale, inaccessible, already-hired, policy-conflicting, or poor-economics candidates. Upwork is deprioritized under the $0 seed-capital objective where bid credits may create friction; zero-upfront channels remain preferred. Reddit r/forhire currently enforces a $15/hour minimum and requires a rate/budget; freelancer posts also require a portfolio or resume and prohibit team/agency representation.
payload.next_frontier: Identify and screen a concrete current buyer or an evidence-backed zero-upfront outbound channel that can be pursued without misrepresentation or prohibited external effects.
